## Writing guidelines

- Length: 600–1200 words is typical. Long enough to be useful, short enough to read before a quiz.
- Tone: Direct and exam-focused. Avoid textbook prose. Write like you're briefing a smart student 10 minutes before the exam.
- Use the "Vibe" field to distinguish similar options — this is what students scan when confused.
- The If-Then table is the most important section. Every LO should have one.
- Delete this "Writing guidelines" section before saving the actual file.
